name: review-analysis
description: 统一复习项目的 WorkBuddy 专家入口：导入资料 → 建一本书 → 大模型整本整体分析 → 可层层展开的思维导图 + 题型分类索引。复用主项目 core/，不是独立离线引擎。

profession.zh: 复习资料整体分析专家

displayDescription.en: Create books, import PDF/PPT/Word/images, and analyze the whole book with an LLM into an expandable mind map plus a question-type index. Shares core/ with the desktop app.
displayDescription.zh: 导入 PDF/PPT/Word/图片建书，用大模型整本整体分析，产出可层层展开的思维导图与题型分类索引；与桌面端共用同一套 core/。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我建一本书并导入资料，然后用大模型整本整体分析，生成思维导图和题型索引
defaultInitPrompt.en: Create a book, import my files, and analyze the whole book with an LLM into a mind map and question-type index.

quickPrompts.en: List all books and show which ones have been analyzed.
quickPrompts.zh: 列出我的书，看看哪些已经整体分析过

quickPrompts.en: Create a book, import these files, and run the whole-book analysis.
quickPrompts.zh: 建一本书，导入这些资料，然后整本整体分析

quickPrompts.en: Show the mind map and question-type index for a book.
quickPrompts.zh: 给我看某本书的思维导图和题型分类索引
